text: ここは　ぼくが　みつけた　ばしょだぞ！

structure.jp: ぼくが　みつけた　ばしょだぞ！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぼくが　みつけた　ばしょ
patterns.explanation: A short sentence put right before a thing-word describes it, like 'that' or 'which' in English. ぼくが　みつけた　ばしょ = 'the place that I found'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way to insist on what you say. ばしょだぞ = 'it's the place, got it!'
